articles.title: What we know so far about deadly fire at Canadian military base
articles.description: At least four people are confirmed to have died after a huge fire swept through the base.

articles.title: Trump says suspension of Russia sanctions is to keep peace negotiations going
articles.description: The US president blocked numerous sanctions on Russia two days before they were due to take effect.

articles.title: Oil facilities hit in deadly overnight attack on St Petersburg
articles.description: At least one person was killed in the strikes, which also hit a data centre used by Russia's equivalent of Facebook.

articles.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
articles.description: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

articles.title: Trump waives several Russia sanctions as row with Zelensky intensifies
articles.description: The US president temporarily ends many restrictions on Moscow recently passed by Congress over "national security" concerns.

articles.title: Teacher fought US school attacker before armed dad shot suspect 'multiple times'
articles.description: The 16-year-old suspect previously attended the primary school and had targeted a special educational needs classroom, police say.

articles.title: Brazil sees record fall in Amazon deforestation as key election looms
articles.description: The Amazon rainforest is a crucial buffer against climate change - but deforestation had expanded under former president Jair Bolsonaro.

articles.title: Trump endorses Netanyahu ahead of Israeli elections, calling him 'great warrior prime minister'
articles.description: Donald Trump has endorsed Benjamin Netanyahu ahead of the Israeli elections later this month, calling him a "great warrior prime minister".

articles.title: Zelenskyy says US taking Putin's side would be 'historic mistake' - as Russian oil sites attacked
articles.description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that the US formally siding with Russia would be a "historic mistake" - as Ukrainian drones attacked oil facilities in St Petersburg.

articles.title: US condemns 'despicable' Israeli settler attack that seriously injured American photographer
articles.description: The US ambassador to Israel has condemned an attack by dozens of masked Israeli settlers on a village's harvest in the West Bank that left several people injured including an American photographer.
